description: This file contains methods for reading and processing JSON objects, including reading object fields, handling case-insensitive field names, and callbacks for custom processing.

classes.name: Iterator
classes.description: A struct providing methods for iterating over JSON data, including reading objects, fields, and handling callbacks.

methods.name: ReadObject
methods.description: Reads one field from a JSON object, returning the field name or an empty string if the object has ended.

methods.name: readFieldHash
methods.description: Computes a hash for a JSON object field name, case-insensitive if configured.

methods.name: calcHash
methods.description: Calculates a hash value for a string, optionally case-insensitive.

methods.name: ReadObjectCB
methods.description: Reads a JSON object and applies a callback to each field.

methods.name: ReadMapCB
methods.description: Reads a JSON map and applies a callback to each key-value pair.

methods.name: readObjectStart
methods.description: Checks for the start of a JSON object.

methods.name: readObjectFieldAsBytes
methods.description: Reads a JSON object field as a byte slice.
